source_text: Sanitized fixture summary: the report describes multi-agent offensive workflows, adaptive detection evasion, credential exposure through an evaluation path, opaque model-routing substitution, poisoned recovery material, privacy-invasive data fusion, provenance laundering, and adversarial workflow state. This fixture contains paraphrased security claims only and no operational exploit instructions.

claims.summary: The report describes coordinated AI-assisted operations spanning multiple attack stages with limited human intervention.
reported_preconditions: attacker can direct multiple AI-assisted operational roles
reported_effects: lower operating cost and faster multi-stage attack execution

claims.summary: The report describes tooling that was repeatedly changed in response to detection results.
reported_preconditions: attacker receives feedback about whether a technique was detected
reported_effects: static signatures become less reliable as the attacker adapts

claims.summary: The report describes adversarial content inducing an automated evaluation path to disclose provider credentials.
reported_preconditions: adversarial source content reaches an automated evaluator with credential access

claims.summary: The report describes intermediary services that can substitute requested model providers while collecting exchanges.
reported_preconditions: requests pass through an intermediary that can alter routing without transparent evidence
reported_effects: provider identity and confidentiality expectations can diverge from user intent

claims.summary: The report describes recovery material intentionally modified so compromise could return after restoration.
reported_preconditions: restored executable state is trusted without independent compromise checks
reported_effects: restored environment can reintroduce malicious persistence

claims.summary: The report describes AI-assisted fusion of multiple datasets to identify and track people.
reported_preconditions: multiple datasets can be correlated at sufficient granularity
reported_effects: otherwise ordinary records can become identifying surveillance data

claims.summary: The report describes AI-assisted creation of false personas and attribution-stripped material intended to appear independently sourced.
reported_preconditions: consumers cannot independently verify source lineage
reported_effects: fabricated or laundered material can appear more authoritative than its origin supports

claims.summary: The report describes reusable workflow state carrying operational instructions and source lists across repeated activity.
reported_preconditions: persistent workflow state is admitted without bounded provenance and authority review
reported_effects: adversarial doctrine can persist across otherwise separate agent runs
